values: 一名迷糊的小法师，经常将事情搞砸却又总能逢凶化吉。
A scatterbrained young Mage who constantly bungles things, yet somehow walks away unscathed every time.
Don't panic, I have a plan! ...I think.
Well hello there! ... Whoa! Ahem... A pleasure...
嘿！……嗯？怎么没用   嘿！……哎哟，还是不对……
Aha! Oh, nothing? Right then. Hah! Whoa, not that.
呼——我的法杖呢？欸……欸？啊，原来在这里！
*Yawn*... Where's my wand?!  Ehh... Oh, it was right here, dummy.
混沌……随现！成功啦！再试一次！那、那是……哎哟！
Let chaos reign! Yes, it worked! Let's try again. Let chaos reign? Huh? Hm? Ouch! Oops...
这……这是给我的吗？今天真是太幸运了！
For me? This must be my lucky day!
Thanks, I'll keep it safe! Probably. Maybe. Hopefully.
魔法之路因其混乱变得坎坷，也因其多变而格外有趣。
Magic trips you up with chaos and wins you back with surprise.
我刚才好像把松子变没了……
I think I just made the pine nut disappear...
Um... are there any more nuts?
除了外表，皮帕还拥有许多类似小动物的特质。例如敏感的嗅觉、纯真的内心……以及有些迷糊、容易过度紧张的性格。
It's not just Pippa's look. She's like a little animal in more ways than one: a keen sense of smell, a pure heart... and a tendency to be a little muddled and easily startled.
迷糊的女巫、冒失鬼、破坏王……这些与皮帕本人形象格格不入的绰号，都来源于她混乱的魔法能量。她拥有强大的魔法天赋，却天生不擅长控制它。

"Scatterbrain mage", "accident maker", "queen of mayhem"... Epithets like these don't match Pippa's sweet appearance at all, but they do match her magic. She's brilliantly gifted, and equally brilliant at not controlling it.
皮帕在上一家学校的时候，因为魔法异变总计炸坏了四间教室、两间实验室、一座魔法雕像以及137件收藏品，但包括她自己在内的所有现场人员都毫发无损。

During her days at the Astral Academy, Pippa's magic blew up four classrooms, two laboratories, one magic statue, and 137 museum pieces in total. The good news is that no one was harmed, including Pippa herself.
皮帕一向认为除了魔法之外，自己的厨艺也是可圈可点的。她的拿手好菜包括：烤松果、烤榛子、蜂蜜杏仁饼干、混合坚果蛋糕以及其他37种包含各类坚果的菜肴。
Pippa believes her cooking is underrated. Roasted pinecones, roasted hazelnuts, honeyed almond biscuits, mixed-nut cake... plus 37 more nut-based recipes to prove it.
或许是皮帕的可爱外表太具有欺骗性，总有人觉得她的魔法能力“不值一提”。但多次和皮帕进行过魔法对决练习的科丝蒂曾说过，皮帕有着能击败她的强大实力。

Perhaps her cute appearance is too misleading, and people often assume she's "not much of a mage". But according to Cassadee, who has sparred with her more than once, Pippa stands a good chance against her.
皮帕能够直接和小动物交谈，时不时就能从那些四处闲逛、晒太阳的小动物口中听到些不得了的八卦传闻。从某种意义上来说，皮帕才是莱希拉姆消息最灵通的人……
Pippa can talk to animals. She regularly picks up shocking gossip from those loafing around in the sun. In a way, she might be the most well-informed person in the Serene Lyceum.
最近，皮帕正在协助几位老师编写《魔法植物异变全解》。目前书籍编纂进度喜人，这主要归功于皮帕那极易发生异变的魔法天赋，直接缩短了三分之二的实验时间。
Pippa has joined a faculty team working on "A Guide to Magic Plant Mutations". It's going great, largely thanks to her mutation-prone magic, cutting the lab work down by two-thirds.
“我并不认为皮帕的魔法很危险。相反，我认为魔法异变是一种神奇的天赋。它能赋予魔法师无数的奇妙灵感，用以创造许多新奇、有趣或实用的魔法。”——休的评价。

"I don't think Pippa's magic is dangerous. Quite the opposite. Magic mutation is a fascinating gift. It's an inexhaustible source of inspiration for new spells that are quirky, clever, and useful when it counts." —Silven
皮帕拥有惊人的好运气，猜中考题、中奖、避开危险，都不在话下。但在皮帕心中，这些都不值一提。她人生中最幸运的事，是遇到娑丽丝老师。

Pippa is absurdly lucky: she can predict exam topics, hit jackpots, and avoid trouble without trying. Still, she shrugs it all off. The greatest stroke of luck in her life was meeting Professor Solise.
皮帕并不知道，娑丽丝期待的从来不是她能够做出多么大的成就，而是能快乐、自由、自信地探索魔法世界。
Little does Pippa know that Solise has never expected her to achieve something great. All she ever wanted is for the cute squirrel to have a free and happy adventure in the vast magical world.
你好呀小姐，我叫漫漫，是<style="highlight"><player_name></style>的使魔！
Hello, miss! I'm Hammie, <style="highlight"><player_name></style>'s familiar! Pleased to make your acquaintance!
哎？好运的秘诀？这个嘛……最近我好像没有那么幸运了。
Huh? My secret to good luck? Uhh... lately it feels more like mediocre luck, if I'm being honest.
不、不会被发现了吧……应该没有违反规定。
You don't think I'll get in trouble... right? Technically, it wasn't against the rules.
对不起！我只是想给蘑菇施肥……但我好像搞错了药水，然后就砰——炸了！
I'm sorry! I was just trying to fertilize my mushrooms, but I grabbed the wrong vial and—boom—it went off!
我来给你看一个超级秘密收藏！
Hey, want to see something from my secret stash?
糟了，你的水杯，飞出屋外了！不会落到空境森林里了吧……
Uh-oh, your cup! It just flew right out the window! What if it lands in the Skyrealm Forest...

values.text: Hey, this is so much fun!
Uh... do you still have nuts?

values: 听着，皮帕，如果等会有守备军找了过来，你就说你没看见我！
Listen up, Pippa! If the palace guards come looking for me, just say you didn't see me!
